Fed & Policy Watch

Today is a Treasury supply and rates-plumbing session: the verified 6-week bill closes at 11:00/11:30 AM ET, the 2-year note at 12:00/1:00 PM, Commercial Paper at 1:00 PM, and H.15 at 4:15 PM. With SOFR at 3.85% and MOVE at 81.20, monitor whether duration demand absorbs supply without tightening the funding impulse.

NFCI remains -0.56, indicating looser-than-average broad conditions, while the 10Y is 5.01%. No NYSE holiday or shortened session is listed for September 22.

Omissions and Watch

BLS omitted: the official September 2026 schedule returned HTTP 403/access denied, so CPI, PPI, employment, and labor releases are not asserted. No Census, EIA, or BEA release is verified for Sep 22. Treasury 13/26-week bills and 52-week/6-week rows later in the week are omitted where exact closing times remain unavailable. NAR is not required for the selected dates.

MOVE 81.20 is moderate uncertainty under the stated 80-120 band; NFCI -0.56 indicates looser-than-average conditions. All listed Treasury rows have date/time support in the refreshed records.

Trading Strategy Note - ES Futures
Base Case

ES overnight 7833.50 is above the September 21 SPY close of 773.50. With the 6-week bill and 2-year note supply windows before Commercial Paper, favor measured continuation only if rates remain orderly. SOFR 3.85%, MOVE 81.20, and 10Y 5.01% argue for smaller size around the auctions.

Invalidation

A decisive ES break outside the overnight range with 10Y above 5.01% or MOVE above 100 invalidates the continuation setup. Reassess after the 1:00 PM Commercial Paper release and 4:15 PM H.15 data rather than chasing the first reaction.
